# Hubbly

> Hubbly is the autonomous revenue operating system for SMBs and mid-market teams. Five product lines — Signal, Rank, Send, Voice, and Spy — run research, content, outreach, and calling from one shared buyer context, on autopilot by default with opt-in approval gates.

Primary verticals: mortgage, insurance, financial services, marketing/sales agencies.

## Product lines
- [Signal](https://hubbly.io/signal): Identifies the buyers behind anonymous website traffic and feeds an engine that acts on what they search.
- [Rank](https://hubbly.io/rank): SEO and AI-engine visibility on autopilot — content, technical fixes, and answer-engine placement, with snapshot, verify, and rollback rails always on.
- [Send](https://hubbly.io/send): The outbound email agent inside the engine — sequencing, deliverability, and replies, with leads and copy arriving already attached from the pipeline.
- [Voice](https://hubbly.io/voice): The conversation layer — reaches buyers, handles the conversation, logs the outcome, and sets the next step in motion.
- [Spy](https://hubbly.io/spy): Watches the page-one field around the searches that pay you and turns every competitor move into a counter-move.

## Key pages
